summary: Vector::ptr_eq incorrectly returns true for cloned full-tree vectors whose outer chunks diverge but whose middle pointer remains shared: the final || bypasses the preceding chunk comparisons. The fix groups the middle-tree alternatives so all chunk comparisons must also succeed. This reversal isolates the ptr_eq correction. The upstream issue_131 test added by the fix checks that modifying a 65-element clone makes ptr_eq return false.

reversal.fixed_text:
cmp_chunk(&left.outer_f, &right.outer_f)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.inner_f, &right.inner_f)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.inner_b, &right.inner_b)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.outer_b, &right.outer_b)
                    && ((left.middle.is_empty() && right.middle.is_empty())
                        || Ref::ptr_eq(&left.middle, &right.middle))
reversal.parent_text:
cmp_chunk(&left.outer_f, &right.outer_f)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.inner_f, &right.inner_f)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.inner_b, &right.inner_b)
                    && cmp_chunk(&left.outer_b, &right.outer_b)
                    && (left.middle.is_empty() && right.middle.is_empty())
                    || Ref::ptr_eq(&left.middle, &right.middle)
